package.name: diy_state_estimate
package.description:
odom-frame state estimation for the DIY Challenge robot.
Runs a single robot_localization EKF that fuses wheel odometry (/wheel_odom, velocities), the ACEINNA IMU (/imu/data, yaw rate) and FAST-LIO2 lidar-inertial odometry (/Odometry, planar pose) into /odom and the odom -> base_link TF consumed by Nav2. Because FAST-LIO2 already fuses the same IMU internally, a small relay node (sensor_covariance_relay) inflates the IMU and lidar covariances before they reach the EKF so the wheel encoders carry real weight and a moving obstacle can no longer drag the robot pose around while the wheels report zero motion.
